messages:
emma: Hey folks, urgent: my nanny canceled last minute and I need to cover my toddler on 2026-12-29 (company year-end freeze Dec 24-31). I have an interview panel at 2pm. Can I swap the local observance to Jan 5 or do I need to take unpaid?

kyle: Sorry to hear that, hope all okay. Short answer: during year-end blackout unscheduled requests require escalation, but managers can approve emergency swaps with a coverage note. Submit the Time-off Adjustment form and attach manager approval.

anika: Adding payroll nuance: if swapping pushes hours into next year and the employee hits carryover cap, that becomes a manual carryover exception. For an emergency same-week swap we often mark it as "emergency unpaid" or approve as scheduled if manager signs and Recruiting confirms coverage.

emma: Manager (Kyle) verbally okayed covering the swap if we can find a backup for the panel. Is there a quick way to mark this as "scheduled" so Recruiting will trust it?

hiring-ops: If you can confirm the swap in writing (Slack thread or email) and file the adjustment before cutoff (we treat verbal + immediate Slack confirmation as OK), we can reassign panels. Post candidate invite and we will propose backup from backup list. Tag @hiring-ops.

emma: Posting here for record: Kyle approved swap: original 2026-12-29 -> new 2027-01-05. Filing the Time-off Adjustment now.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = 2026-12-24 to 2026-12-31 UTC. For emergency swaps include manager approval + coverage_plan. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end

emma: Filed form (submitted 2801234569). Chose type: "one-time emergency swap" and added coverage_plan: "Recruiting backup assigned: Priya; on-call coverage: team rotation". Attached Kyle's Slack approval.

anika: For payroll: set `payroll_action: emergency swap - treat as scheduled`. If this later causes accrual/carryover conflict we'll follow up with a carryover exception. Given this is emergency and not elective, Payroll usually processes as scheduled unless it creates cap issues.

kyle: Hiring-ops, can you confirm candidate panel backup?

hiring-ops: Confirmed: Priya will take the 14:00 slot; please update calendar invites and note in candidate thread. Also add a one-line note in the Time-off Adjustment coverage_plan: "Priya cover 14:00 panel" so recruiters see it in the HR ticket.

emma: Calendar updated and candidate invites forwarded to Priya. One more thing: if I later want to bank the Jan date into a floating day instead of just swapping, is that allowed after the fact?

anika: You can request banking to float, but that is treated separately and must be approved by manager and People Ops. If it's after year-end it will be a carryover/banking request and may require `cross_tax_year: yes`. For emergencies we typically leave as a swap unless employee requests bank-to-float within 30 days.

emma: Understood. Thanks everyone for the quick help.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-6120 (emergency childcare swap & interview coverage). Assigned to Anika.
